why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: 1 Step 1 : Open the Harmonix rewards page Go to the Harmonix rewards page , which hosts Season 1 and shows your points and the leaderboard.
2 Step 2 : Connect your wallet Use the connect wallet button so the site can load your points and positions. No ID check is shown on the site.
3 Step 3 : Pick a vault Browse the yield markets and choose a vault. Each vault lists its deposit total, APY and any extra rewards.
4 Step 4 : Deposit funds The Rewards page names USDC, USDT and HYPE as deposit assets, so check which asset each vault takes before you deposit. Deposits earn Harmonix points daily during Season 1.

5 Step 5 : Keep your deposit and check your points Hold the deposit to build the time factor and keep loyalty status. Check your totals on the Rewards page , where the partner points note says points are updated every 10 minutes.
